parties: GMR Estate Management Private Limited (acquirer) & GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited (target)
headline: GMR Estate Management discloses acquisition in GMR Power and Urban Infra under SEBI Regulation 10 exemption
sum: GMR Estate Management Private Limited filed a disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011 Regulation 10(6) with NSE, reporting an acquisition in GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited made in reliance upon an exemption provided under Regulation 10.
implication: Regulation 10 exemptions (typically used for acquisitions by persons acting in concert, or exempted acquirers like those acquiring from founders/promoters) are material gating mechanisms in multi-step control transactions; the specific exemption invoked and resulting shareholding % will determine future disclosure thresholds under Regulation 31.
detail: GMR Estate Management Private Limited, a related entity, has made an acquisition in GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited (a listed company on NSE) and filed the mandatory disclosure with the exchange under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) Regulations, 2011. The filing invokes Regulation 10(6), which permits disclosure of acquisitions made under exemption categories rather than the general Regulation 31 threshold-triggered regime. The exemption route suggests the acquirer falls within a protected category (likely concert parties or promoter-related acquirer) or the acquisition mechanics fall within a carved-out provision.

framework.note: Exemptions from general takeover disclosure thresholds; multiple sub-clauses cover concert parties, acquisitions from founders, and specified investor categories.
Specific reporting obligation for acquisitions made in reliance upon Regulation 10 exemptions; requires disclosure to exchange even if general Regulation 31 threshold not crossed.
General disclosure threshold (25% incremental or 5% in any financial year if aggregate exceeds 25%); likely superseded here by Reg 10 exemption.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 – Section 372 (as amended; now repealed and integrated into SEBI regime)
framework.note: Provides statutory backing for SEBI's takeover regulations; acquirer obligations and insider trading contraints during open window.
Applicable during acquisition window; GMR Estate Management and concert parties subject to trading halts and disclosure of price-sensitive information.

framework.ref: Listing Agreement / NSE Rules – Chapter XI (Substantial Acquisitions)
framework.note: Exchange-level procedural requirements for disclosure timing, content, and public filing of Reg 10 exemption notices.

framework.ref: SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 – Regulation 8 (Trading by Employees and Other Persons)
framework.note: Restrictions during acquisition period on trading by GMR Estate Management personnel and promoters of both entities.

conditions: Acquisition made in reliance upon Regulation 10 exemption (specific exemption category not disclosed in primary source)
approvals: NSE disclosure filing accepted and published
structure.novel: Use of Regulation 10 exemption by GMR Estate Management (likely an intra-group or related-party acquirer) rather than standard Regulation 31 threshold disclosure route; suggests structuring around concert-party or founder-acquisition protections.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure of acquisitions made under Regulation 10 exemptions to the stock exchange; triggers filing obligation regardless of shareholding quantum.

The specific exemption relied upon (concert parties, promoter-related, institutional investor, etc.) gates the scope of Regulation 31 future disclosures and determines whether an open offer is triggered post-acquisition.
